en-US.description:
Misbaha is a tasbeeh and adhkar counter from Zikr Apps — calm, private, and built for daily dhikr.

• Count duas with tap, double-tap, or long-press
• Morning, night, and Quranic adhkar
• Goals, insights, and themes
• English and Urdu
• All counts stay on your device

Published by Zikr Apps.
